title: Emerging investigator series: post-wildfire sediment geochemical characterization reveals manganese reactivity and a potential link to water quality impairment in the Gallinas Creek watershed, New Mexico
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00326A, Paper
Elizabeth J. Tomaszewski, Sheila F. Murphy, Johanna M. Blake, Michelle I. Hornberger, Gregory D. Clark
Water quality post-wildfire can become impaired by increased turbidity and elevated concentrations of elements such as manganese (Mn) and iron (Fe).
